test.name: Spec 0010 spike: kqueue EVFILT_PROC exit watch and reap

expected: kqueue EVFILT_PROC NOTE_EXIT (with NOTE_EXITSTATUS for children) reports the exit of a child, a suspended child and a non-child, a registration on an exited child fails with ESRCH and waitpid(WNOHANG) then reaps it (spec 0010 AC-9, Adapter macOS row Exit)
actual: Child: NOTE_EXIT|NOTE_EXITSTATUS registers on the suspended child; after SIGCONT and SIGTERM the event carries the wait status exited(0) in data, and waitpid(WNOHANG) reaps exited(0). Discarded suspended child: event data signaled(9). Non-child orphan: NOTE_EXIT registers and fires (data 0); NOTE_EXIT|NOTE_EXITSTATUS also registers for a non-child and fired with data 0 for a clean exit, so the adapter cannot tell a real status from 0 there and must report None, as spec 0010 says. The start time re-read after registration still matched. Exited-but-unreaped child (zombie): registration returns ESRCH, then waitpid(WNOHANG) reaps it with exited(0), which is the spec's ESRCH path. Absent pid: ESRCH. launchd reaps the orphan within 2 s of its exit.
